title: imec: Novel High Density 3D Buffer Memory Enabled by IGZO Channel Charge Coupled Device
query: IGZO charge-coupled device charge transfer efficiency oxide semiconductor CCD
supports: imec already pursues an IGZO-channel 3D CCD buffer memory for 3D-NAND-style integration: planar 4-phase 142-bit prototype, CTE >98% (per-transfer vs end-to-end not stated in snippet), retention >200 s, endurance >1e10 cycles, >6.25 MHz (via search snippet; abstract level)

title: 3D n-Capacitor-Stacked FeRAM for Energy-Efficient Non-Volatile DRAM Applications (Sogang University thesis)
query: 1T-nC ferroelectric capacitor stacked shared transistor plate line 3D FeRAM IEDM
supports: 1T-nC stacked FeRAM shares one storage node and transistor across plate-line-selected capacitors; disturb of unselected 'victim' capacitors on the shared node is the central problem, mitigated with a VDD/3 inhibit bias on 7 nm HZO (via search snippet)

title: Stacked ferroelectric non-planar capacitors in a memory bit-cell (US 11423967)
query: 1T-nC ferroelectric capacitor stacked shared transistor plate line 3D FeRAM IEDM
supports: Patent family on vertically stacked ferroelectric capacitors sharing a plate in one hole and accessed by a single select transistor below it: plate-selected 1T-nC prior art for FeRAM (nonlinear capacitors); no diode-steered linear-capacitor DRAM version surfaced (via search snippet)
